description_en: Retrieves a list of alert sources
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-alert-source --level remind --start-time 1577808000000 --end-time 1577808000000 --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAlertSource

parameters.help_en:
The threat levels. Valid values:

`serious`: High

`suspicious`: Medium

`remind`: Low
parameters.help_zh:
威胁等级，格式为json数组。取值：
serious：高危
suspicious：中危
remind：低危
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of view. Valid values:

`0`: View data for the current Alibaba Cloud account.

`1`: View data for all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member whose data you want to view. An administrator uses this parameter to view data from the perspective of a specific member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the data management center for threat analysis. Select the data management center that corresponds to the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

`cn-hangzhou`: for assets in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).

`ap-southeast-1`: for assets in regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en: The status code of the response. A value of 200 indicates success

Source.description_en: The internal code for the alert source
Source.description_zh: 告警数据源名称美杜莎code
Source.title_zh: 告警数据源名称美杜莎code。

SourceName.description_en: The name of the alert source

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
Success.title_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
